versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 introduces a workflow for producing Russian, one-page A4 summaries for Sber’s board.

- Accepts PDF and DOCX reports; supports OCR for scanned PDFs.
- Applies sector-specific rules when extracting facts and checks numbers against the source pages.
- Verifies summary claims against document quotes; unsupported claims are excluded after three rounds.
- Consults the local Sber knowledge base when preparing discussion questions; web search requires user consent.
- Produces a PDF summary. Human review is recommended before sharing.
